citation: Mallet J. (1972) 'Paralysie obstétricale du plexus brachial', Rev Chir Orthop 58(Suppl 1):166-168; Bae DS, Waters PM, Zurakowski D. (2003) 'Reliability of three classification systems measuring active motion in brachial plexus birth palsy', J Bone Joint Surg Am 85(9):1733-1738 -- the standard reference for the pediatric OBPP Modified Mallet Score's 5 categories (Global Abduction, Global External Rotation, Hand to Neck, Hand to Spine, Hand to Mouth), each graded I (no function) to V (normal).
notes: Mallet's original I-V descriptions are qualitative clinical observations (e.g. 'reaches neck with marked abduction'), not device-measured angle cutoffs. The gradingRules below are a documented OPERATIONALIZATION into automatable thresholds -- an interpretation choice this app makes explicit and versioned, not a verbatim transcription of the published criteria. These are initial defaults, not fit to clinician-labelled outcome data (none exists yet for this system) -- see docs/mallet-score.md and shared/assessment/ModifiedMalletScoreEngine.js for the calibration-readiness design intended to let a future clinician-labelled dataset retune these via a new published version, never an in-place edit.

globalAbduction.label: Global Abduction
globalAbduction.citation: Bae et al. 2003 -- band thresholds operationalized from the published qualitative grade descriptions, see top-level notes.

globalExternalRotation.label: Global External Rotation
globalExternalRotation.citation: Bae et al. 2003 -- band thresholds operationalized; measured via the existing externalRotationDeg proxy (shared/biomechanics/angle-computation.js), valid near ~90deg elbow flexion which this task's instruction enforces.

handToNeck.label: Hand to Neck
handToNeck.citation: Bae et al. 2003 -- the published criteria weigh both reach and how much compensation was needed to achieve it, operationalized here as an ordered rule set rather than a single-value band.

handToSpine.label: Hand to Spine
handToSpine.citation: Bae et al. 2003 -- the published criteria are graded by vertebral level reached; operationalized here via the vertebralLevelProxy bucket (see measurementProxies above and shared/assessment/mallet-measurements.js for its documented limitations).

handToMouth.label: Hand to Mouth
handToMouth.citation: Bae et al. 2003 -- the published criteria are graded primarily by how much shoulder abduction/scapular winging compensation is needed, not raw speed; operationalized here via shoulderFlexionDeg (how much shoulder movement was needed) and trunkCompensationFlag rather than the task's recorded completionTimeSec, which is context, not the grade driver.

internalRotation.label: Internal Rotation (supplementary item -- NOT part of the classic 5-category Mallet 1972 / Bae et al. 2003 scale; a locally-defined addition to this app's protocol, graded I-V using the same ordinal philosophy for consistency)
internalRotation.citation: Locally defined -- see docs/mallet-score.md for provenance. Measured via the existing internalRotationDeg proxy, whose documented valid operating window (~90deg elbow flexion) does not match this task's hand-behind-back posture -- see measurementLimitations in ModifiedMalletScoreEngine.js output for this task.
